note: The harness blocked writing findings.md / recommendation.md ('Subagents should return findings as text, not write report files'). This JSON is the durable copy; the narrative is in the structured output returned to the lead.
verdict: DO NOT START i18n. Ship the plural/agreement consolidation instead. It is a real user-visible fix today AND the precondition for any future translation.
whySolo Dentist Gains Nothing From i18n: There is exactly one real organization in the database (4a3420d1, «Стоматология, 1 кабинет», clinic_mode=one_chair, 4 users, 3 patients, 1015 audit events). The other three organizations are fixtures. A Russian solo dentist gains zero measurable value from a second UI language. What that dentist DOES see today is wrong Russian number agreement on the schedule summary and the odontogram multi-select.

recommendedPacket.name: Единый русский помощник согласования числа (shared/utils/plural.ts)
recommendedPacket.sizeEstimate: 1 new module + 1 new test + 1 export line + 4 call sites
recommendedPacket.precedentItFollows: packages/shared/src/utils/money.ts is the sanctioned single-owner arithmetic module, exported via packages/shared/src/index.ts:8413 'export * from "./utils/money.js";' and tested at packages/shared/src/tests/money.test.ts under 'node --import tsx --test "src/**/*.test.ts"'. The plural module mirrors that exactly, so it invents no new contract (§10).

files.what: pluralRu(count, one, few, many) plus countWithNoun(count, [one,few,many]) returning '<count>\u00A0<form>'. Algorithm is already proven twice in-tree; this is consolidation, not invention.
node:test cases for 0,1,2,3,4,5,11,12,13,14,21,22,25,101,111,112 — the 11-14 exception and the 2-4 branch are where both existing copies could have gone wrong.
export * from "./utils/plural.js";  — do not touch anything else in this 8400+ line file.

`Выбрано: ${selectedTeeth.length} зубов` is reached only when length > 1, so it prints «Выбрано: 2 зубов» for 2,3,4 (and 22-24, 32-34, 42-44). Replace with countWithNoun(selectedTeeth.length, ["зуб","зуба","зубов"]).

`${appointmentCount} записей` prints «1 записей» when the busiest doctor has one appointment — the normal case for a solo practice. Card is rendered at ScheduleView.tsx:730 behind the «Показать аналитику» toggle (plain useState at :191, one click, no clinicMode gate).
Local `function pluralRu(count, one, few, many)` — correct, but exported nowhere and used only at :223 and :254.
A second independent hand-rolled Russian plural rule (lastTwo 11-14 branch, last 2-4 branch) inline in a component.

orderOfWork: 1. Write packages/shared/src/utils/plural.ts and packages/shared/src/tests/plural.test.ts FIRST; prove the table before any UI file is touched.
2. Add the single export line in packages/shared/src/index.ts near :8413.
3. Replace the two duplicated helpers (PatientCommunicationTimelineWidget, InventoryView) with imports — behaviour must not change, that is the regression guard.
4. Only then fix the two wrong sites (OdontogramModule, ScheduleView).
5. Lead re-runs: npm run typecheck; npm run test -w @dental/shared; npm run check:encoding.
whatWouldMakeItFailReview: Installing any i18n library. Nothing is installed (verified: 0 i18n-ish deps across all 4 package.json, 0 dirs in node_modules, 0 runtime call sites). Proposing one turns a fix into a project.
Touching the return block of apps/web/src/useAppLogic.tsx — breaks the typecheck of 50+ files (UI_STANDARDS.md God-Context constraint).

Touching useAppLogic.tsx:7353 (`${speechRecoveryIssueCount} запись требует внимания`, also wrong). That is speech-recovery text and speech is FROZEN after 5 failed reviews. Report it, do not patch it.
Sweeping the 34 «строк(и)» / «пациент(ов)» / «платеж(ей)» parenthetical dodges in 18 files. They are ugly but not WRONG; folding them in is scope creep.
Touching packages/shared/src/utils/money.ts. formatKopecksRu hardcodes RU conventions on purpose (comma decimal, NBSP grouping, ₽) and §8b makes it kopeck-exact. Out of scope.
Introducing Intl.PluralRules as part of this packet. It is native and would work, but the hand-rolled rule is already proven twice in-tree; swapping instruments while consolidating mixes two risks.
Any git add of another agent's files — three builders hold source concurrently.

separateFindingNotBundled.summary: Audit reason writes the RAW English enum key instead of the Russian title map, so the audit log shows «patient удалено 12, сохранено 3» to a Russian user.

evidence.source: engine.ts:887 uses `${outcome.entityKind}`; the same file uses migrationEntityKindTitles[...] at :168, :319, :487. The map exists at packages/shared/src/migration.ts:123-134 (patient→«Пациенты», appointment→«Записи в расписании», ...).
evidence.reachability: GET /api/audit/logs (apps/api/src/routes/audit.ts:38) does a bare .select() with no projection, so reason is returned; apps/web/src/components/settings/SettingsAuditTab.tsx:2157 renders {event.reason} verbatim; the tab is mounted at apps/web/src/SettingsView.tsx:1590.
evidence.databaseStatus: NOT YET OBSERVED. migration_runs has 4 rows, all status='validated', zero 'rolled_back', all in org 4a3420d1. audit_events reasons matching a bare latin entity kind: 0 rows. The defect requires an import rollback to have run, and none has.

separateFindingNotBundled.whyNotBundled: Different owner, different app, and it needs one line plus a rollback to observe. Bundling it with the web plural fix would make one packet span api+web+shared.

languageSelectorVerdict.claim: A control that cannot keep its promise (§3). CONFIRMED, and stricter than the prior dossier said.
evidence: packages/shared/src/index.ts:7620 — uiLanguageSchema = z.enum(["ru"]). The type system forbids a second value.
apps/web/src/AppHelpers.tsx:2894-2896 — uiLanguageLabels = { ru: "Русский" }; :2906 uiLanguageOptions = [defaultUiLanguageOption] (array literal, length 1).
apps/web/src/AppHelpers.tsx:3620-3622 — normalizeUiLanguageInput returns "ru" for every input, so the onChange handler is a provable no-op.
apps/web/src/AppHelpers.tsx:2903 — the subtitle promises «Выбор сохраняется автоматически и остается до смены языка.» There is no language to change to.
TWO render sites, not three: rg -n 'value=\{uiLanguage\}' → apps/web/src/App.tsx:2615 and apps/web/src/components/settings/SettingsClinicTab.tsx:446.
languageSelectorVerdict.correctsPriorDossier: R3-i18n-route §F2 lists THREE render sites, the third being apps/web/src/components/workspace/onboarding/inline/InlineStepClinic.tsx:75-90. That file does not exist (rg: IO error, os error 3). R3 also cites uiLanguageSchema at index.ts:7449; it is now :7620.
whereItPersists: Server side it lands in users.ui_preferences JSON — apps/api/src/db/settingsQuery.ts:67-75 — selected with .limit(1) and NO orderBy, i.e. an arbitrary user row of the organization.
DATABASE FACT: information_schema has ZERO columns matching '%lang%' or '%locale%' in the whole public schema. Language is only ever a key inside that JSON blob.
languageSelectorVerdict.architecturalCeiling: Because preferences are read from one arbitrary user row per organization, a language choice would be CLINIC-WIDE, not per-user. Two staff in one clinic could not pick different languages. DB evidence: in org 4a3420d1, 2 of 4 users carry ui_preferences with different savedAt (e44d32ca owner 11:00:00Z, 8356141b doctor 10:59:00Z) — but BOTH savedAt are dated 2026-05-20, which PREDATES the organization's own created_at of 2026-07-27, so they are SEEDED constants and do NOT prove runtime drift. What they do prove: the writer can land on more than one row while the reader only ever reads one.

hardBlockers.grammaticalAgreement: Partially SOLVED and the solution is the model to copy. apps/web/src/lib/panelStateText.ts (337 lines, imported by ~18 files) removed the «Статус не загружены» class by making the caller supply notLoadedTitle as a WHOLE pre-agreed fragment instead of concatenating title + 'не загружены' (see its own comment at :72-76). BUT its PanelSubject interface has a field literally named `accusative` (:80), consumed as `Загружаем ${subject.accusative}…` (:181). Russian morphology is baked into the contract's field names, so translating means reshaping the interface, not swapping strings.
hardBlockers.pluralisation: NOT SOLVED. Intl.PluralRules: ZERO uses in the whole repo. One correct helper pluralRu exists in ONE file (PatientCommunicationTimelineWidget.tsx:163) and is exported nowhere; a SECOND independent copy is inline in InventoryView.tsx:55-62; 34 sites in 18 files dodge the problem with parenthetical endings «строк(и)», «пациент(ов)», «платеж(ей)», «приём(ов)»; and 52 sites interpolate a count directly before a fixed Russian noun.
hardBlockers.dateFormatting: 98 calls of toLocale{Date,Time,}String('ru-RU'); 35 Intl.* uses across 16 files. Locale is a hardcoded literal at every site, never read from uiLanguage.
hardBlockers.moneyFormatting: packages/shared/src/utils/money.ts:191-200 formatKopecksRu is a hand-rolled Russian formatter (comma decimal, NBSP grouping, ₽ suffix, U+2212 minus) — not Intl.NumberFormat. Another locale needs a second formatter held to the same kopeck-exactness as §8b.
hardBlockers.layoutWidth: LOWER than the brief assumes, for the realistic first target. Tailwind whitespace-nowrap: 2 uses. white-space:nowrap in CSS: 65 occurrences across 12 files (main.css 33, dente-redesign.css 9, dente-operations.css 8) — invisible to any Tailwind-class audit. But RU→EN makes text SHORTER, which leaves gaps rather than clipping. The 30-50% expansion trap only bites translating INTO a longer language.

dictionaryAdoption.why both: They answer different questions. 28.5% of the strings are already extractable in one move; only 4.6% of the JSX positions the user looks at actually read from a map. R3-i18n-route's 17.9% measured the first kind of thing, not the second.

treeChurn.finding: Any absolute i18n volume number rots within hours, so plan a RULE, never a line budget.
treeChurn.evidence: Re-running R3-i18n-route's own commands 5 hours later: apps/web/src 20004->21877 lines while FILES fell 362->357; apps/api/src 19743->22205 lines, 283->300 files. And that is with two 4244- and 2623-line files deleted in between.

priorDossierCorrections: R3-i18n-route §F4 'worst files' credits SmartImportStudio.tsx with 460 bare literals and §F2 names LegacyMigrationStudio.tsx. Both files no longer exist (ls: No such file or directory).
R3-i18n-route §F2 claims 3 render sites for the language selector; there are 2. InlineStepClinic.tsx is gone.
R3-i18n-route §F2 cites uiLanguageSchema at packages/shared/src/index.ts:7449; it is at :7620.
R3-i18n-route §F4 reports 17.9% dictionary coverage. Not wrong, but it is not the coverage of what the user sees: only 4.6% of JSX text positions read from a lookup.

My own RC1 brief states there are 2 organizations. The database has 4: 4a3420d1 (real), d0000000 (screenshot fixture), and TWO more created 2026-07-28T17:02 — dce70000-...-0902 «Клиника диктовки Б» (0 users, 0 patients) and dce70000-...-0901 «Клиника личного кабинета» (0 users, 1 patient). Only ONE is real.
